description: Fetches network logs for a specific automation test

platform.description: The platform type: "web" for browser automation, "app" for app automation

sessionId.description: Required for app platform: the session_id of the app session, a UUID that listMobileSessions and getAutomationTestDetails return (not the test ID)

testId.description: The ID of the automation test

name: getAutomationTestNetworkLogs
title: Get Automation Test Network Logs
